ia_integration.sixth_tab: NO. SITE and TREE live inside existing tabs.
ia_integration.PROJECT: Journey + WORKING TREE. Tree has its own deep-linkable child route /app/:slug/project/tree (?node=<id>) because it is a full-screen place and the target of VIEW IN TREE.
ia_integration.REVIEWS: Family review gains a DESIGN | LIVE segmented control. LIVE becomes the primary authority once the family reached live implementation.
ia_integration.LIVE VIEWER: Full-screen client viewport overlay route /app/:slug/live/:nodeId (deep link from tree, review, notification). Not a tab.
ia_integration.FINAL REVIEW: A review of kind FINAL at /app/:slug/reviews/:reviewId with segments SITE · TREE · SUMMARY; surfaced on HOME as NEEDS YOU when ready.
ia_integration.why: Keeps the locked 5-tab nav; matches the starting hypothesis; tree is understanding (PROJECT), live is judging (REVIEWS).

two_review_modes.SITE: live working product review inside client viewports
two_review_modes.rule: Same review object, same approval events — modes are views, not separate reviews.

when_live_applies: A family whose implementation_status ≥ IMPLEMENTED on the review build. Before that, DESIGN (authority) is the only mode. Never substitute a screenshot/mockup for a live implementation that exists.
family_live_review_screen: KEY REVIEW NOTES (founder-written: what to try)

design_vs_live.DESIGN: what was approved as the visual target (authority)
design_vs_live.client_explanation: One line: "DESIGN SHOWS THE APPROVED TARGET. LIVE IS THE WORKING PRODUCT BUILT FROM IT."

live_interaction_allowed: switch viewport to verify responsive behaviour
review_scenarios: Optional founder-curated starting points per family (e.g. "NEW USER", "RETURNING USER WITH DATA"); each is a seeded demo dataset + entry route. RESTART FLOW resets the scenario.

data_safety.isolation: Serve the reviewed project from a separate review origin or a sandboxed iframe WITHOUT allow-same-origin. Today project runtimes (JURNL) mount same-origin under /production/:slug/runtime/* and can read host localStorage (auth backup, Supabase session) — acceptable for founder preview, NOT for client live review.
data_safety.writes: Live review builds run against a demo backend or with writes disabled; no real emails, payments or provider calls.

approval_binding: Approval records which mode(s) the client opened (design_viewed, live_viewed, viewports_viewed) — evidence for the final review, never a requirement to approve.
reuse: DesignChamber VIEWPORT live iframe (WORKING_END_TO_END today) — the only live-preview mechanism in the repo
founder_controls: mark family LIVE-REVIEWABLE (choose review build + scenario)
